purpose: Review a finite Campaign126 catalog for a genuinely new historically versioned point-in-time information state after all 149 complete definitions and prior source histories, without opening a source row or research value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: repurchase_execution_or_completion_intensity
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Initial repurchase plan ratio, amount and freshness already have terminal low-capacity evidence, and the prior contract deliberately excluded later progress and completed amounts. Reintroducing proc, implemented volume or completed amount is a post-result field rescue rather than a new information domain.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: aggregate_share_pledge_ratio_state
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The documented output has end_date and pledge statistics but no announcement or publication timestamp. A historical end-date row therefore cannot be activated point-in-time without an external disclosure clock. Detailed pledge announcements, ratios, counts and freshness are already terminal and cannot be used to infer that clock.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: business_segment_revenue_concentration
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The documented output exposes report end_date and mutable segment labels but no announcement date. It cannot supply a stable 2019-2025 point-in-time activation rule, and later segment taxonomy revisions cannot be projected backward.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: institutional_survey_attention_or_disclosure_delay
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Institution counts, same-day event counts, freshness and announcement delay have already passed through frozen capacity and terminal diagnostic branches. A new aggregation window, institution subtype or delay transform would retry an exposed event source.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: margin_financing_or_securities_lending_pressure
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: existing margin and margin-detail source history
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Financing net buying, purchase amount, balance, balance growth and normalized balance plus securities-lending sell/repayment state already have terminal histories. Rewindowing or switching between these fields is not a new economic state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: historical_listing_lifecycle_as_alpha_factor
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A point-in-time listing/delisting archive would improve universe construction and reduce the disclosed current-listing survivorship limitation, but it is research infrastructure rather than an independent alpha mechanism. It cannot be scored as a factor or used to rerun terminal campaigns under a changed universe.

selection.reason: Every finite proposal is a terminal field/operator retry, lacks a lawful point-in-time publication clock, or is universe infrastructure rather than a distinct alpha state.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Begin only from a separately identified historically versioned point-in-time information domain; preserve all Campaign126 rejections and the exact 149-definition/139-comparator library.
